 IMAX (IMAX) Could Be 18% Undervalued After Meta VR Deal And Strong Q3 Results
 BA Bailey Pemberton November 16, 2026, 00:26 UTC Share Why IMAX stock is back in focus
 IMAX (IMAX) just lined up two attention grabbing catalysts: a fresh content and hardware partnership with Meta’s upcoming VR glasses and a third quarter earnings release showing higher revenue and net income.
 IMAX shares trade at $48.29, with a year to date share price return of 34.06% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 37.97%. The 3 year total shareholder return of 182.89% and 5 year total shareholder return of 163.88% point to momentum that has been building as recent earnings and the Meta VR tie up reshape how investors view the company’s growth potential and risk profile.
 Scan the wider immersive entertainment space by comparing IMAX with hand-picked peers that have been screened for strong fundamentals and breakout potential in 19 high quality undiscovered gems .
 After a 34% year to date jump and a splashy Meta VR deal, IMAX is no longer a forgotten small cap. Does the current valuation still leave enough upside to justify fresh risk for new buyers?
 Advertisement Most Popular IMAX Narrative: 18% Undervalued
 IMAX last closed at $48.29, while the analyst consensus Narrative on Simply Wall St anchors fair value at $59.17, which implies an 18.4% discount when those long range cash flow assumptions are run through a 9.06% discount rate.
 Rapid acceleration of new system installations and a replenishing, geographically diverse backlog supported by an estimated addressable market of 4,500 screens versus about 1,800 currently in operation points to further IMAX network expansion that could lift box office driven revenue and recurring cash flows as more locations contribute. 
 See why 9 investors see IMAX as 18% undervalued .
 Result: Fair Value of $59.17 (UNDERVALUED) 
 Still, IMAX faces two clear pressure points: a thinner blockbuster slate that could affect box office linked revenue, and rising competition from at-home streaming and gaming.
